integrity: The complete face poset, gradient-path DAGs and integral Morse boundary are reconstructed in the standalone verifier; published results are distinguished from the computed multiplicities. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the finite six-dimensional hypercube at intrinsic graph Čech scale three is classified; no general-dimensional claim or other persistence maps are proved.
title: The integral homotopy type of the six-cube graph Čech complex at scale three
